phone.changelog: v3.4.1: Dead-title filter — a title whose every stream fails leaves the catalog and search until sources recover. Direct streams (m3u8/mp4) now always play before embed mirrors, best quality first, so 404 error pages can no longer appear inside the player. Background health sweep quietly removes dead titles from the home screen.

tv.changelog: v3.12.73: Movies & series fixed — movibox CDN hotlink gate (429) handled: native player now sends Referer/UA headers; web/phone playback streams through the VPS proxy. Live channel thumbnails fixed — dead Sony logos repaired, logos served via image proxy with retry. Live channel playback untouched.

android_tv.changelog: v3.12.93: Streaming reliability — direct streams always play before embed mirrors (best quality first), dead titles leave the catalog and search until sources recover, background health sweep removes dead titles from home. No more 404 pages inside the player.
